defs.def: to frighten sb 惊吓；使害怕；使恐惧

ex.s: “If you’re scared about something and thinking only about that, there’s no way you’re going to be able to learn,” Ho says.
ex.t: 你必须平衡创作一个不可预测但又不能凭空出现的结局，一个适合角色发展的结局。

ex.s: I sometimes call him back, worried that he might have someone ____12____ (scare).
ex.t: 所以这是我的建议：以身作则。

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Sometimes loud noises like these will scare bears off.
ex.t: 我用无线电呼叫营地管理员求助。

ex.s: We're scared of the things that we don't understand.
ex.t: 我们害怕我们不理解的事物。

ex.s: Jeff had   54   in lowa before Thanksgiving with his dog, Rosie, but the gun shots had scared the dog off.
ex.t: 杰夫在感恩节之前带着他的狗罗西到了爱荷华州，但枪声把狗吓跑了。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 永远不要让别人告诉你，"你不行。"大胆梦想，奋力攀登！
一个人的成功归功于家人的支持。

defs.def: to become frightened 受惊吓；害怕；恐惧
a situation in which a lot of people are anxious or frightened about sth 尤用于报章

ex.s: As the line of people came toward me, I got a little scared.
ex.t: 当人群朝我走来时，我有点害怕。

defs.def: a sudden feeling of fear 惊吓；惊恐

ex.s: It strengthened people's long held idea of the great white shark as a dangerous animal.People have always been scared of sharks, but Jaws made things worse.
ex.t: 这强化了人们长期以来将大白鲨视为危险动物的观念。人们一直都害怕鲨鱼，但《大白鲨》使情况变得更糟。

ex.s: People have always been scared of sharks because they are considered 1______.
ex.t: 人们一直害怕鲨鱼，因为它们被认为是1______。

ex.s: I suddenly feel a bit scared.
Although she is clearly still in some pain, her scared and anxious look has been replaced —first by a small smile, and then by loud laughter as I "magically" produce her sock from out of my pocket.
ex.t: 虽然她显然还有些疼痛，但她那害怕和焦虑的表情已经变了——先是一丝微笑，然后变成大笑，因为我"魔法般地"从口袋里变出了她的袜子。

ex.s: Robutt would knock him out of trouble when he was too near a rock, jump on him to show how much he loved him, or go round in circles making noises as if he was scared when Jimmy hid behind a rock.
ex.t: 当Jimmy太靠近岩石时，Robutt会把他从麻烦中推开；会扑到他身上表达对他的爱；或者当Jimmy躲在岩石后面时，Robutt会转着圈发出声音，好像很害怕的样子。
